dialogue.title: dom_aela_quietforge
dialogue.context: Aela works only hand tools at home, quiet enough that the East Arm hammers remain the loudest truth.
dialogue.farewell: Go before the next hammer fall.

quest_hooks.summary: Identifies the source warehouse for tampered cooling water.

dialogue.title: dom_arvek_stormcup
dialogue.context: Arvek recognizes the cooper's mark that was burned off Keth Varr's suspect casks.
dialogue.farewell: Watch the chain on your way out.

branek-coiljaw.role: East Arm bench-holder and road marshal

quest_hooks.summary: Commissions a witness to audit the broken Dorthkor muster.

dialogue.title: dom_branek_coiljaw
dialogue.context: The Road-Bench keeps Dorthkor's broken drumbeat beside every open commission.
dialogue.farewell: Go before the next hammer fall.

dialogue.title: dom_brannic_lowdrum
dialogue.greeting: Yield is an honest word here.
dialogue.context: Brannic plays beneath the Hammer Roar by feeling the mugs walk across the table.
dialogue.farewell: Stand straight when the drum sounds.

quest_hooks.summary: Is the missing chain hand named in the harbor watch report.

dialogue.title: dom_brek_saltjaw
dialogue.context: Brek did not report after the outer harbor chain tightened itself during the night watch.
dialogue.farewell: Watch the chain on your way out.

quest_hooks.summary: Provides the missing name from the Crossing census.

dialogue.title: dom_brinna_fourbells
dialogue.context: Brinna's midwinter census contains one crossed-out name that still answers at each gate.
dialogue.farewell: Leave me a true count when you return.

quest_hooks.summary: Must be confronted about a suit taken from a forbidden ledge.

dialogue.title: dom_daska_threeknots
dialogue.context: Daska prices cleaned armor by the grief of the family asking and calls that brutal honesty.
dialogue.farewell: Leave me a true count when you return.

dialogue.title: dom_dorran_rask
dialogue.context: Dorran soles road boots differently for the Trial Roads, where every climb leans the same way.
dialogue.farewell: Leave me a true count when you return.

quest_hooks.summary: Offers forge access at a warm Shattersteel Concord reputation band.

dialogue.title: dom_drann_wetiron
dialogue.context: Drann reserves the honest forge for names the Concord already speaks warmly.
dialogue.farewell: Go before the next hammer fall.

quest_hooks.summary: Supplies the official score from the broken-yield duel.

dialogue.title: dom_drel_gaunt
dialogue.greeting: Yield is an honest word here.
dialogue.context: Drel's slate proves the yielded duelist was struck three times after the surrender beat.
dialogue.farewell: Stand straight when the drum sounds.

quest_hooks.summary: Seeks proof of how a living guard's tag reached cleaned armor.

dialogue.title: dom_droma_flintjaw
dialogue.greeting: Hold at the brace and state your business.
dialogue.context: Droma's armor tags include one clean plate whose owner still answers morning roll.
dialogue.farewell: Cross unarmed or do not cross.

quest_hooks.summary: Offers a veteran escort at a warm Iron Companies reputation band.

dialogue.title: dom_edda_broadmark
dialogue.greeting: Yield is an honest word here.
dialogue.context: Edda reads the Company's standing before she reads a volunteer's scars.
dialogue.farewell: Stand straight when the drum sounds.

quest_hooks.summary: Gates access to the sealed road archive behind verified watch proof.

dialogue.title: dom_enna_grayscar
dialogue.context: Enna opens sealed road records only for someone carrying proof from the matching watch.
dialogue.farewell: Leave me a true count when you return.

dialogue.title: dom_gerren_pike
dialogue.context: Gerren judges a pike by whether the bearer can see their scar in its edge.
dialogue.farewell: Go before the next hammer fall.

quest_hooks.summary: Requests recovery of a storm-damaged road register.

dialogue.title: dom_hadrik_vale
dialogue.context: Hadrik can account for every road ledger except the one that returned with rain inside its seals.
dialogue.farewell: Leave me a true count when you return.

quest_hooks.summary: Is the missing miner sought by the lift crew.

dialogue.title: dom_hennik_coalvein
dialogue.context: Hennik missed shift after chalking a name that no foreman remembers onto the lift cage.
dialogue.farewell: Go before the next hammer fall.

quest_hooks.summary: Shares a safe sea-mouth route at a warm Wayfare-Mender reputation band.

dialogue.title: dom_holst_brinevein
dialogue.context: Holst saves his storm-proof route for travelers the Mender lodges trust.
dialogue.farewell: Watch the chain on your way out.

quest_hooks.summary: Seeks the hall that abandoned an unidentified trial-broken veteran.

dialogue.title: dom_irka_stonebreath
dialogue.context: Irka keeps the trial-broken names and has one patient no hall admits sending.
dialogue.farewell: Watch the chain on your way out.

quest_hooks.summary: Names the veteran connected to a cold place at the charfire table.

dialogue.title: dom_istra_hearthscar
dialogue.context: Istra remembers which missing veteran stopped eating when the Wound began using Company voices.
dialogue.farewell: Go before the next hammer fall.

dialogue.title: dom_jessa_longbrace
dialogue.context: Jessa splices every brace rope with four turns and cuts any sailor who adds a fifth.
dialogue.farewell: Leave me a true count when you return.

quest_hooks.summary: Asks someone to find a missing Company veteran without shaming them.

dialogue.title: dom_jorun_ashmantle
dialogue.context: Jorun keeps the charfire table open, but one veteran's bowl has gone cold for six nights.
dialogue.farewell: Go before the next hammer fall.

quest_hooks.summary: Removes the Pillar barricade after its burden pins are repaired.

dialogue.title: dom_kadrin_stoneyield
dialogue.greeting: Yield is an honest word here.
dialogue.context: Kadrin keeps the damaged ascent roped off and counts every candidate turned away.
dialogue.farewell: Stand straight when the drum sounds.

quest_hooks.summary: Holds the hound needed to follow an absent Company soldier.

dialogue.title: dom_kaelra_pikehand
dialogue.greeting: Yield is an honest word here.
dialogue.context: Kaelra's oldest hound tracks one absent Bloodbellow and refuses every other scent.
dialogue.farewell: Stand straight when the drum sounds.

quest_hooks.summary: Explains the hidden condition in a Restoration contract.

dialogue.title: dom_kelm_rook
dialogue.context: Kelm found a Restoration clause that hires a Company by the dead names on its old roll.
dialogue.farewell: Go before the next hammer fall.

quest_hooks.summary: Gates the night road behind matching warning and Council clearance.

dialogue.title: dom_kessa_nightrail
dialogue.context: Kessa opens the night road only when the Dorthkor warning and the Council seal agree.
dialogue.farewell: Leave me a true count when you return.

quest_hooks.summary: Requests samples from a suspect storm-water delivery.

dialogue.title: dom_keth_varr
dialogue.context: Keth says the newest cooling-water seals are honest bronze wrapped around dishonest water.
dialogue.farewell: Go before the next hammer fall.

dialogue.title: dom_kiva_saltbrand
dialogue.context: Kiva keeps storm salt dry in retired drumskins and labels every skin by cadence.
dialogue.farewell: Watch the chain on your way out.

quest_hooks.summary: Provides the guard's original posture and direction.

dialogue.title: dom_korrin_blackrail
dialogue.context: Korrin saw the cleaned guard face outward before the first gate opened.
dialogue.farewell: Leave me a true count when you return.

quest_hooks.summary: Gates access to an unidentified hospice patient behind a hall token.

dialogue.title: dom_loa_flintthread
dialogue.context: Loa keeps patient names private until a scarred-hall token proves honest concern.
dialogue.farewell: Watch the chain on your way out.

quest_hooks.summary: Asks the player to compare an impossible cadence against old muster notation.

dialogue.title: dom_maela_drumscar
dialogue.context: Maela heard a dead Company's cadence answer between two beats of the spring muster.
dialogue.farewell: Go before the next hammer fall.

quest_hooks.summary: Provides required information about a compromised Council message.

dialogue.title: dom_marn_veld
dialogue.context: Marn carried the sealed vote between the four benches and knows which seal arrived warm.
dialogue.farewell: Leave me a true count when you return.

quest_hooks.summary: Reopens the hospice charfire table after the medicine delivery.

dialogue.title: dom_mera_voss
dialogue.context: Mera has banked the charfire until medicine reaches the trial-broken ward.
dialogue.farewell: Watch the chain on your way out.

quest_hooks.summary: Is the signaler who can reproduce the unknown gate reply.

dialogue.title: dom_nalla_gatebeat
dialogue.context: Nalla stopped the third gate's drum after it answered with a signal no living watch uses.
dialogue.farewell: Leave me a true count when you return.

dialogue.title: dom_nym_vara
dialogue.context: Nym sells cups broad enough to catch rain and narrow enough not to lose it to the wind.
dialogue.farewell: Watch the chain on your way out.

quest_hooks.summary: Holds access needed to inspect an abandoned charfire place.

dialogue.title: dom_orenna_caskbrand
dialogue.context: Orenna holds the only kitchen key to the scarred hall where an unnamed bowl remains set.
dialogue.farewell: Go before the next hammer fall.

quest_hooks.summary: Gates a controlled forge-silence behind a replacement cadence.

dialogue.title: dom_orm_redtongs
dialogue.context: Orm permits a forge shutdown only after a replacement hammer cadence is proven.
dialogue.farewell: Go before the next hammer fall.

quest_hooks.summary: Needs a route marker carried to a storm-stranded crew.

dialogue.title: dom_orren_chainwake
dialogue.context: Orren has a storm-stranded crew below the sea-mouth and one safe course left unmarked.
dialogue.farewell: Watch the chain on your way out.

dialogue.title: dom_orrik_cinderjaw
dialogue.context: Orrik trims hair with forge shears and never lets their hinge lose the hammer rhythm.
dialogue.farewell: Go before the next hammer fall.

quest_hooks.summary: Needs the brace drums tested from both sides of the chasm.

dialogue.title: dom_pell_hammersong
dialogue.context: Pell hears a fifth echo under a four-beat Jawbrace signal whenever the western storm turns.
dialogue.farewell: Leave me a true count when you return.

quest_hooks.summary: Reveals a Wound-Watch ledger entry at a warm Sentinel reputation band.

dialogue.title: dom_raika_toll
dialogue.context: Raika answers respect for the Sentinels with one more true entry from the Wound ledger.
dialogue.farewell: Leave me a true count when you return.

quest_hooks.summary: Must inspect a suspect veteran's counterfeit brand.

dialogue.title: dom_ressa_ironmouth
dialogue.context: Ressa can spot a false Ironbrand by the way its scar fails to pull when the bearer speaks.
dialogue.farewell: Go before the next hammer fall.

dialogue.title: dom_saela_windscar
dialogue.context: Saela reads tomorrow's western wall by which roof flag tears first.
dialogue.farewell: Leave me a true count when you return.

quest_hooks.summary: Changes the market display when the recovered suit's fate is decided.

dialogue.title: dom_sava_mor
dialogue.context: Sava leaves an empty armor stand in her window until the ledge suit is returned or condemned.
dialogue.farewell: Go before the next hammer fall.

quest_hooks.summary: Opens the silent bell-house investigation.

dialogue.title: dom_sella_varn
dialogue.greeting: Yield is an honest word here.
dialogue.context: The district bell is warm, the rope is sound, and Sella refuses to call its silence a simple break.
dialogue.farewell: Stand straight when the drum sounds.

quest_hooks.summary: Offers the cut net for investigation at the sea-mouth.

dialogue.title: dom_senn_brinehook
dialogue.context: Senn's newest net came back cut from below, with every knot retied in marching order.
dialogue.farewell: Watch the chain on your way out.

quest_hooks.summary: Distinguishes a living caller from the dead muster echoes.

dialogue.title: dom_sorek_hushward
dialogue.context: Sorek hears the calls before dawn and knows which ones come in a living voice.
dialogue.farewell: Leave me a true count when you return.

quest_hooks.summary: Restores the memorial cadence after the missing roll is recovered.

dialogue.title: dom_tern_hollowbeat
dialogue.context: Tern holds a deliberate silence where the lost road roll should have sounded.
dialogue.farewell: Leave me a true count when you return.

quest_hooks.summary: Requests an independent account before ruling on the living muster.

dialogue.title: dom_themka_gaath
dialogue.context: The Bridgeholder weighs the Wound-Watch ledger before any voice on the Council floor.
dialogue.farewell: Leave me a true count when you return.

quest_hooks.summary: Decodes the break between dead and living muster rolls.

dialogue.title: dom_thessa_drumline
dialogue.greeting: Yield is an honest word here.
dialogue.context: Thessa can point to the exact beat where a living roll enters the cadence of the unremembered.
dialogue.farewell: Stand straight when the drum sounds.

dialogue.title: dom_thora_bellmark
dialogue.greeting: Yield is an honest word here.
dialogue.context: Thora inks no promise until the speaker can say its price without lowering their voice.
dialogue.farewell: Stand straight when the drum sounds.

quest_hooks.summary: Asks for the missing offerings from the Drownedmouth tide-chain.

dialogue.title: dom_toma_reedhand
dialogue.context: Toma tends the river shrine between harbor shifts and knows which tide-chain offerings have gone missing.
dialogue.farewell: Watch the chain on your way out.

quest_hooks.summary: Keeps the resonant hammer required for a forge-silence inquiry.

dialogue.title: dom_torv_bellowskin
dialogue.context: Torv locked away a hammer that rings after the forge around it has fallen silent.
dialogue.farewell: Go before the next hammer fall.

quest_hooks.summary: Carries the disputed manifest needed by the market factors.

dialogue.title: dom_umber_dhor
dialogue.context: Umber carries a manifest for grain that reached Dom twice on paper and not once by sack.
dialogue.farewell: Watch the chain on your way out.

quest_hooks.summary: Requests a source trace for ash entering a storm cistern.

dialogue.title: dom_vaara_cisternhand
dialogue.greeting: Yield is an honest word here.
dialogue.context: Vaara has sealed a cistern whose rain tastes of forge ash before it reaches the East Arm.
dialogue.farewell: Stand straight when the drum sounds.

quest_hooks.summary: Gates use of a chasm-wall lift behind the completed safety tally.

dialogue.title: dom_varrik_deepchalk
dialogue.context: Varrik will not mark a descent cage until the lift crew's safety tally is complete.
dialogue.farewell: Go before the next hammer fall.

quest_hooks.summary: Prioritizes a needed archive drawer at a warm Registry reputation band.

dialogue.title: dom_venn_ashcord
dialogue.context: Venn waives no line, but a warm Registry record earns the useful drawer first.
dialogue.farewell: Leave me a true count when you return.

quest_hooks.summary: Commissions an inquiry into altered Trial Pillar weights.

dialogue.title: dom_veska_ruun
dialogue.greeting: Yield is an honest word here.
dialogue.context: Veska found three Pillar weights filed smooth where a candidate's name should be cut.
dialogue.farewell: Stand straight when the drum sounds.

quest_hooks.summary: Identifies the ash on recovered salvage cloth.

dialogue.title: dom_veyra_sootlace
dialogue.context: Veyra knows whether ash came from forge coal, charfire, or a suit scoured below the ledges.
dialogue.farewell: Go before the next hammer fall.

quest_hooks.summary: Moves from the shrine to the outer chain after the watch-hand search resolves.

dialogue.title: dom_yara_chainstep
dialogue.context: Yara will return to the outer chain when the missing watch hand is accounted for.
dialogue.farewell: Watch the chain on your way out.

quest_hooks.summary: Is the harbor witness another quest must locate.

dialogue.title: dom_yssra_coldnet
dialogue.context: Yssra saw lights climbing the harbor wall against the rain and will speak only beside calm water.
dialogue.farewell: Watch the chain on your way out.
